claims.value: Welden places 5,000 Austrians compressed in the bridgehead after falling back from Engerau on 3 June.
claims.rationale: Narrative bridgehead population after initial withdrawal, not necessarily the opening village defenders. English rendering (ours): "Here five thousand Austrians were now crowded into a small space."
